name: Gehazi (Elisha's servant)
title: The Greedy Servant
summary: Gehazi was the personal servant and assistant of the prophet Elisha. He witnessed many of Elisha's miracles, but his greed led to him being struck with leprosy after lying to obtain gifts from Naaman, the Syrian army commander.

keyEvents.title: Servant to the Shunammite Woman
keyEvents.description: Gehazi suggested to Elisha that the hospitable Shunammite woman could be blessed with a son, since she was childless and had an old husband.

keyEvents.title: Attempt to Raise the Boy
keyEvents.description: When the Shunammite woman's son died, Elisha sent Gehazi with his staff to lay it on the boy's face, but this did not work.

keyEvents.title: Greed Toward Naaman
keyEvents.description: After Elisha healed Naaman and refused to accept gifts, Gehazi ran after him and lied to obtain silver and clothing.

keyEvents.title: Punished with Leprosy
keyEvents.description: When Gehazi lied to Elisha about where he had been, the prophet exposed his deceit, and Naaman's leprosy struck Gehazi and his descendants forever.

keyEvents.title: Tells the king about Elisha's miracles
keyEvents.description: Gehazi told King Joram about all the great things Elisha had done, including raising the Shunammite woman's son.
